demo.title: unsigned-inspection.txt
demo.code: Inspect one public address without a wallet or payment signature. Read the x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; a 402 is only an offer, not a sanctions match or payment. Default spend is zero. Purchases require explicit approval and a separately reviewed capped client.

setup: Review the text-only skill; installation neither contacts Obol nor authorizes payment.
Confirm consent to disclose the exact public address; inspect the current contract and unsigned challenge.
API lookups cost USDC on Base; observed price 0.005 USDC on 2026-11-11, including nonmatches. Verify the current quote.

Before payment require explicit provider, address, network, per-call/total caps, call count and expiry approval, enforced by a separately reviewed user-controlled client. Otherwise stop after unsigned inspection.
